lines.caption: This is a tour of pull request 67, which gives sessions a short PR digest and ends endless rounds of low review findings.
lines.say: This is a tour of pull request sixty-seven, which gives sessions a short PR digest and ends endless rounds of low review findings.

lines.caption: It has three parts: what the PR adds, how it was built and verified, and what comes later.
Part 1. What this PR adds.
A read-only digest agent, and four rules on how the agent reads and answers CI's reviews.
When a session needs a PR's CI state, it asks the digest agent, passing what it saw last time.
The agent reads CI's four comments, the checks, the commits and the owner's comments in full, in its own context.
It parses the hidden JSON markers CI writes, not the Markdown tables.
And it returns about 20 lines: checks, finding totals, new findings, the audit and a merge rule verdict.
lines.say: And it returns about twenty lines: checks, finding totals, new findings, the audit and a merge rule verdict.

lines.caption: When a review raises findings, all their fixes go out in one push.
After that one round, low findings nobody confirmed are accepted on an explainer-only commit.
Medium, high or confirmed findings are still fixed, or brought to the owner.
And the merge rule now counts findings that are fixed, resolved, or accepted under these rules.
Why: on PR 62, the review raised 36 findings over 7 pushes, and the session reread a huge comment each time.
lines.say: Why: on pull request sixty-two, the review raised thirty-six findings over seven pushes, and the session reread a huge comment each time.

lines.caption: The digest always prints the totals, so a finding it leaves out is still counted.
The session passes the PR number, and after the first time, the last head and the highest finding seen.
Trailers that accept findings are checked too, and a range of IDs is flagged, since CI reads only its two ends.
Accepted findings are listed one by one in a Review-accept trailer, on a commit CI doesn't review.
Unconfirmed medium or high findings still need a fix, and its commit message names each one.
The PR touches the new agent file, the rules file, and this explainer.
A session that started before the merge can't call the agent by name, so it runs a general agent on its file.
Part 2. How it was built and verified.
It was built from how CI writes its markers, then tried on PR 62 and on this PR's own CI rounds.
lines.say: It was built from how CI writes its markers, then tried on pull request sixty-two and on this PR's own CI rounds.

lines.caption: It follows the screenshot auditor agent, and the two scripts that write the review state and parse trailers.
On PR 62's final state, the digest came back in 18 lines with every finding counted.
lines.say: On pull request sixty-two's final state, the digest came back in eighteen lines with every finding counted.

lines.caption: It flagged one medium finding the owner accepted outside the PR, which is the judgement it should leave to the caller.
On this PR, the digest summed up each review in about 20 lines, and each round's fixes went out in one push.
lines.say: On this PR, the digest summed up each review in about twenty lines, and each round's fixes went out in one push.

lines.caption: Calling the agent by name needs a session started after the merge, so that wasn't run.
A fresh agent reviewed the diff and found eight problems. All eight are fixed.
The biggest: CI marks medium and high findings unconfirmed too, so only low ones now count as accepted.
CI's own first review found nine more, five of them medium. All nine are fixed in one push.
Its second review found seven more, five confirmed. They were fixed in a second push.
The third found eight. The three confirmed ones were fixed, and the five unconfirmed lows were accepted under the new rule.
The fourth found six: three confirmed, fixed, and three lows accepted the same way.
Two things can only be seen after the merge: the agent called by name, and a second round of lows closed by one commit.
Part 3. What comes later.
Nothing depends on this PR, but issue 66 cuts the rest of the noise.
lines.say: Nothing depends on this PR, but issue sixty-six cuts the rest of the noise.

lines.caption: CI would edit its comments only when they change, so a watching session wakes less often.
That's the PR: short reads of a PR's state, and review rounds that end after one fix.
